name: lance_3b_mlx (image variant)
description: MLX safetensors port of ByteDance Lance image-3B weight. Verified byte-identical with the original PT-side conversion target.

source_pt.note: Same weight family as the original PT release; our conversion preserves bf16 float values byte-equal.

conversion.dtype: preserve (PT bf16 → MLX safetensors, float values byte-equal)

verification.byte_identical_with: RockTalk/Lance-3B-MLX (independent conversion of the same PT source — same SHA256)
stages_validated: STAGE 2: Qwen2 backbone forward cos = 1.000000 vs PT
STAGE 4: MoE-gen routing cos = 1.000000 vs clean PT re-impl
STAGE 5: image VAE round-trip ≥ 40 dB PSNR (T=1)
STAGE 6: T2I 30-step latent cos ≥ 0.999 vs PT 30-step
STAGE 7: TI2I 3-forward cos ≥ 0.999 vs PT, real-photo edits match RockTalk reference
STAGE 8: 3D Causal video VAE 4 gates cos = 1.000000 (encode + decode byte-clean)
STAGE 9: t2v 30-step per-step latent cos ≥ 0.999, video pixel cos = 0.999338 vs PT

notes: This safetensors file covers the LLM backbone + adapters + ViT-out projection. The Wan 2.2 VAE weight is loaded from a separate file (checkpoints/Wan2.2-VAE-MLX/model.safetensors).
The video variant (Lance_3B_Video, ~28 GB) is a separate release; see repo README for status.
Conversion path bf16-preserving: PT and MLX share identical floating-point bit patterns, so cos = 1.000000 at the conversion gate is by construction, not by luck.
